surfaces.condition: A material feature, behavior, command, workflow, integration, security, or quality/release surface changes.
validation: Update this matrix in the same change with the affected surfaces, documentation, tests, and evidence.
For an isolated internal change with no surface impact, record a reviewed no-impact reason in the same change record.

surfaces.condition: Repository guidance, quality commands, secret-path policy, or environment-contract enforcement changes.
Agent routing, repository commands, completion criteria, or contributor guidance changes.
Dependency overrides or the resolved dependency graph change.
Preflight or documentation generation changes its applicability detection, evidence wording, rollback contract, or persisted metadata.
validation: Generate evidence for a CLI-only fixture and verify absent hosted-service surfaces are stated as not detected rather than invented.

surfaces.condition: The current source association, semantic oracle or mapped behavior changes.
validation: Run affected Compass proofs and exact-diff completion.
Preserve pnpm run ci, environment:contract, mandatory QR and security dependency audit; keep unbound outcomes visible.
